newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil's Sleipner West output running to schedule.
newsitem.headline: Statoil's Sleipner West output running to schedule.

text.p: Gas and condensate production at the North Sea Sleipner West development was running at around 15 million cubic metres per day, operator Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday.
The field came onstream at the end of August, one month ahead of schedule and 2.6 billion crowns under budget.

The development comprises two platforms, the unmanned Sleipner B wellhead unit and the T gas treatment installation. The T-platform reduces the carbon dioxide (CO2) content from the gas to 2.5 percent from around nine percent.
The stripped CO2 is injected into a waterlogged structure 1,000 metres beneath the seabed.
About one million cubic metres of CO2 per day were being removed from the gas stream, the company's Status Weekly newsletter said.
